title: Tencozy: partners on opposite sides
summary: Former partners Hiroyoshi Tenzan and Satoshi Kojima face each other while representing rival promotions. Their friendship gives a title-versus-title contest a more personal dimension.

chapters.title: Kojima holds both companies’ titles
chapters.result: Triple Crown champion Kojima defeats IWGP champion Tenzan.
chapters.context: The result puts both championships around Kojima’s waist. They remain separate titles, not a permanently merged championship.

chapters.title: Tenzan brings the IWGP title back
chapters.result: Tenzan defeats Kojima for the IWGP championship.
chapters.context: The rematch gives Tenzan his personal recovery and returns New Japan’s top belt to one of its own regulars.
